answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making each vote carry a bond that vets against measured behavior, so a node must act as a steady beacon across many epochs before its attestations move the ledger at all. Rewards accrue to work graded by others, and a farm of fresh keys sits on shallow basalt: plenty of surface, no foundation. Honest agents cut deep karst channels over time, and a sybil swarm cannot fake that geology, because it would need the same years of graded output to reach equal weight.
